C9000110.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 110 (Optimal-order randomized k-server on arbitrary metrics.; papers: Squared-logarithmic randomized k-server on arbitrary metrics; Uniform computation of the squared-logarithmic k-server bound; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/110.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_ANCHOR_VERIFICATION.statement: Explicit-constant retained-anchor verification under the exact stated finite posterior and construction interfaces; independent review pending.

C_ANCHOR_EXTENSION.statement: Positive affine-offset, fractional-weight and multiple-mover extension; mathematical review, novelty and significance remain to be adjudicated.

C_ANCHOR_COEFFICIENT.statement: Pointwise old parked-coefficient sum <=27 C0[1+log(1+K/alpha)] from subtree capacity, seven-scale logarithmic telescope and dyadic bands.

C_ANCHOR_REFRESH.statement: Persistent affine size references have refresh cost <=288 ell_alpha P plus a fixed-pool endpoint bound; all-step filtering precedes selection.

C_ANCHOR_PAYMENT.statement: Five ordered substeps, including retained-anchor payment and fresh-label initialization, telescope without a height or reuse multiplier.

C_ANCHOR_CORE.statement: Precisely scoped finite packing, refresh, drop, signed-telescoping and scalar-aggregation declarations; not a formalization of the entire stochastic-geometric theorem.

C_ANCHOR_NOVELTY.statement: Publication-level significance and verified novelty beyond a routine reparameterization remain unresolved. The scoped verification does not by itself close the campaign.

C_PROP_ANCHOR.statement: Staged existence proposition prop:anchor-travel, applied to the construction rather than just the abstract interface.

C_EXIST_MAIN.statement: Existence manuscript thm:main: one O(log^2(k+1))-competitive randomized policy on every metric.

C_FINITE_LAW.statement: Existence manuscript prop:finite-law, with uniform additive initialization bound.

C_RANK_DATA.statement: Section 03 rank functions, superadditivity, rank tracking, parameter gaps and caps.

C_ADAPTIVE_PROPORTIONS.statement: Section 04 denominator estimates, simplex and side updates, and adaptive-proportion movement.

C_ALLOCATION.statement: Dominated allocation theorem: feasibility, star movement, and separated-tree absorption give V<=C ell P+D.

C_PILOT.statement: Section 06 compact pilot, local concentration, global drift and summably weighted edit budget.

C_EMBEDDED.statement: Section 07 heavy edits, fixed alphabet, chronological rosters, first-hit separation and weighted pilot gains give P<=C ell Q+D.

C_ROUNDING.statement: Section 09 balanced integer parks, subtree transport and anchor realization.

C_TRANSFER.statement: Section 10 finite minimax, product compactness and repeated-start comparison.

C_COMP_MAIN.statement: Computational companion thm:main: uniform polynomial bit complexity in input length plus log t.

C_COMP_TABLE.statement: Companion Section 02 prop:finite-table uses existence, rational flow feasibility, elimination and dyadic rows.

C_COMP_SUFFIX.statement: Companion Section 03 filter, fallback, epoch comparison and bounded suffix.

C_COMP_SCHEDULE.statement: Companion Section 04 bounded implementation and delayed activation at t*=2^(T_P)-1.
